environment.description: Same Terraform provider API backend deployed behind an ALB (Application Load Balancer) with AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached. The WebACL includes the AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in default action (BLOCK), plus a custom rule evaluating QUERY_STRING with text transformation 'URL_DECODE' followed by 'NORMALIZE_PATH_WIN' applied before the managed rule inspection. The WAFv2 association uses scope REGIONAL on the ALB ARN. Note: the managed SQLi rule set uses internal tokenization that operates on the post-transformation request components, meaning fullwidth Unicode characters in query parameters are evaluated after the ALB's HTTP/2 frame decoding but the WAF text transformations do NOT include explicit Unicode normalization (no 'UNICODE_NORMALIZE' transform exists in WAFv2). The rule group's detection signatures rely on libinjection-based fingerprinting which tokenizes the normalized byte stream.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAFv2 WebACL association (regional scope)

waf_custom_rules.name: query-string-sqli-detection
waf_custom_rules.statement: SqliMatchStatement on QUERY_STRING with text_transformations: [URL_DECODE, COMPRESS_WHITE_SPACE]

config.compute: EC2 t3.medium behind ALB target group
config.note: WAFv2 SqliMatchStatement uses libinjection which performs its own internal character normalization during SQL fingerprint detection
